720-1806-2034-7918.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-7918.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

728-3179-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3179-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-3480-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

225-3129-4365-6753-7942.description:

Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

851-3129-4772-4826-7942.description:

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

4872-6927-7370.description:

Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from exile to the battlefield.
When Damage Control Crew enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.

2946-4871-6112-6797.description:

When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve Daydream, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.

Repeat

Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.

Resolve the Flourishing Defenses trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Skeleton Ship trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

Evolution Witness triggers, returning Iron Apprentice from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Llanowar Scout.

Once you have infinite Oozes with a +1/+1 counter on them, you may remove those counters to create an infinitely large Ooze using Ooze Flux.

Repeat each turn.

Hullbreacher replaces the card drawn with you creating two Treasure tokens.
